Your AI can make 3D now.

Install our free 3D skills for Claude, then ask it for a chair.

It checks 3,500+ free 3D assets first. If nothing fits, it makes a new model from your words.

No account. No API key.

three.ws/docs/agent-skills

checks.claim: it makes a new model from your words

checks.target: the free catalog answers a chair search
the free catalog holds 3,500 or more assets

issues.problem: Sits close to the short-sentence drumbeat structure the voice contract warns reads as copywriting, though unlike a banned drumbeat each statement is a checkable fact verified in the skill files, not a bare adjective.
issues.fix: Optional: merge into 'No account or API key needed.' if a second pass is ever required; acceptable as shipped.

altText: A three.ws card reading 'Your AI can make 3D now.' beside a browser window showing the free three.ws object library: a grid of CC0 3D models including an alarm clock, a ceramic vase, an American football and an arm chair, each with Preview, AR and Download buttons

editor.summary: Every claim passes verification: the live catalog holds 3,961 assets (supporting '3,500+'), the skill files confirm the catalog-first behavior, text-to-model generation, and the no-account no-key requirement, and the link serves HTTP 200. The image matches the copy (free library including an arm chair), alt text is accurate, and the only note is a minor style nudge on the 'No account. No API key.' closing, which is factual and verified rather than adjective copywriting.
